notes.text: Review Wistia’s account-wide Privacy Mode before embedding videos. It disables session and cookie tracking and anonymizes IP addresses while retaining aggregate viewing data, so individual viewer histories and attribution will be reduced.

Wistia’s Privacy Mode is not a promise of no browser storage: non-tracking cookies and local storage can remain. Live events using a Wistia registration form can still collect identifiable event data while Privacy Mode is enabled.
